title: North Ostrobothnia: 2.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €98,500 a year
markdown:
# North Ostrobothnia: 2.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €98,500 a year

> Closes 2.5 of 7.1 missing patients a year (35%) · €98,500 of €1.00M · €901,500 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Ostrobothnia, 24 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 7 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 14.2 patients a year are missing (range 8.5–19.4). [^care_curative][^model] Compared with Finland, 0.0 fewer are operated and 7.1 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative][^model] In the OYS collaborative area, waits from diagnosis to treatment are no longer than in Finland: 31.2 days against 36.9. [^care_time_to_treatment] Fewer are treated to cure. [^care_curative] The county's share is below the 29.7% that residents' age predicts. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.6% to 24.8% by 2028: 2.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–5.0), for €98,500 a year, about €40,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 35% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (7.1 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €44,000 | 1.7 (0.0–3.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.6% → 24.4% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €54,500 | 0.8 (0.0–1.7) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.6% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€98,500** | **2.5 (0.0–5.0)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €1.27M a year; modelled to avoid 2.2 deaths a year (0.5–5.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.6% (2019–2023, measured) → 24.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €901,500 buys nothing more. [^model] €98,500 a year already buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure, and those measures are limited by the shortfall they can reach, not by money. [^model] More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision. [^model] Ranking measures by deaths avoided would also open other options. [^model] About 165 people a year die of lung cancer in North Ostrobothnia, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 of those deaths (0.0–1.5). [^deaths][^model]

## Limits

- Effects are assumptions. Each range runs from all lowest to all highest values together, and is not a probability. Main figures use central values. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, fitness, histology, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. In a check, 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]
